unusualActivityAlertToast:
🛑 Google block detected — Flow service block (NOT Flow Factory's issue)
{count} blocked tiles accumulated

Possible causes:
• Excessive requests in short time
• Account suspicious activity
• Content policy violation
• Multiple automation tools on same IP

Recommended actions:
1. ⏸ Pause and wait 10~30 minutes
2. Switch to another Google account
3. Stop other automation tools on same IP/VPN
4. Check Flow page directly (reCAPTCHA, etc.)

More info: labs.google/fx/help
unusualActivityAutoPauseToast:
🛑 Google block detected → Auto-paused ({count} accumulated)

Continuing will worsen your reCAPTCHA score.

Recommended:
1. Wait 10~30 min then click ▶ Resume
2. Switch to another Google account
3. Check Flow page directly
unusualPatternAutomationToast:
🤖 Automation-suspected block pattern — {count} blocked ({success} succeeded)

Almost all requests blocked from the start.
Google likely classified this as automation.

💡 Recommended actions:
1. ⏸ Pause and rest for 1~2 hours
2. Switch to another Google account
3. Stop other automation tools on same IP/VPN
4. If using VPN, try switching to regular IP
unusualPatternContentToast:
📋 Content-policy block suspected — partial block ({count} blocked / {success} succeeded)

Only some prompts blocked. Likely Google content policy violation.

💡 Recommended actions:
1. Review blocked prompts — see policy below
2. Rewrite with fictional persons/situations
3. ⏸ Pause then ▶ Resume to continue rest

⚠️ Content policy blocks are NOT eligible for refund
unusualPatternGradualToast:
📉 Gradual block pattern — reCAPTCHA score accumulated ({count} blocked / {success} succeeded)

Initially normal but blocks increased over time.
Flow server lowered your reCAPTCHA score due to accumulated requests.

💡 Recommended actions:
1. ⏸ Pause and rest 30~60 minutes
2. Click ▶ Resume after waiting — usually works
3. Split large batches into smaller runs
unusualContentPolicyNotice:
⚠️ Important Notice — Google Content Policy

"Unusual activity" can be caused by prompt content,
not just automation detection.

Google automatically blocks these content types:
• Real people (especially politicians, celebrities)
• Political events (elections, protests, rallies)
• Violent or shocking scenes
• Religion, race, sensitive topics
• Copyrighted characters/brands

These will be blocked the same way in ANY tool,
not just Flow Factory. This is Google's policy itself,
and NOT eligible for refund.

💡 Rewrite with fictional persons/situations and most prompts will work.
